messages:
sara_sales: Quick heads-up — FinArc legal wants a minimal compliance bundle for the POC starting Mon 4/12. They specifically asked for: SOC 2 Type II (scoped), ISO27001 excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation, network diagram, and staging access instructions. Also asked whether Dedicated pricing covers single-tenant isolation (they might require it). Can we assemble a lightweight package and a draft pen-test letter today?

mike_seccops: Roger. I'll compile the checklist and upload artifacts. Short plan: 1) Attach redacted SOC2 summary 2) ISO cert screenshot 3) Draft pen-test letter for signature 4) Network diagram + blast radius note 5) Staging creds + KMS separation note. ETA: EOD. Who signs the pen-test attestation on our side?

alexa_engineering: For signatory we usually have Head of Security or Security Director sign. I'll put together the small network diagram and a one-page KMS separation excerpt (we call out customer-managed keys for Private). Uploading links to internal share once ready. Note on Dedicated: single-tenant (reserved GPU pool + VPC peering) is available; rough uplift is ~+30% over standard Dedicated. @tim_ps can confirm exact numbers.

tim_ps: Confirmed. For a 4-week POC the Dedicated isolation add-on is roughly +30% (details depend on GPUs and burst). I'll DM the formal quote to you, @sara_sales. If they want on-prem instead that's a different SOW and timeline.

sara_sales: Thanks. Legal also asked that the pen-test attestation include "no outstanding critical findings at time of letter" language and identify the testing window. Can we get a draft that includes that?

mike_seccops: Yep — here's a short template to start from (feel free to copy/edit):

```
[Company Letterhead]
Date: [MM/DD/YYYY]
To: [Customer Name]
Subject: Penetration Test Attestation

This attests that Redwood Inference engaged [3rd-party vendor] to conduct a penetration test covering the production and staging environments between [start date] and [end date]. At the time of issuance, there were no outstanding critical vulnerabilities identified that would materially affect confidentiality, integrity, or availability of customer data for the scoped systems.

Signed,
[Head of Security Name]
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
```

I'll route to Legal for signature approval.

audit_bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: https://internal.box.com/s/redwood-evidence/finarc-poc-v1.zip (permissions: sales+security view). :package:

alexa_engineering: Staging access plan: we will provision ephemeral creds scoped to read-only inference endpoints, no write, TTL 7d. Command we use internally: `./infra/tools/create-staging-creds --project finarc --role read-only --ttl 7d` I'll include that snippet and a sample JSON of the allowed endpoints in the bundle. Also attaching a tiny network diag (DM link): https://redwood.box.com/s/diag-finarc (internal).

sara_sales: Perfect. Can we also include a short note about data handling (no retention for PII logs, default masking) — FinArc asked specifically about logs?

mike_seccops: Added a 1-paragraph data handling statement (redacted) and a snippet showing log retention defaults. Will redact customer-specific examples before upload.

sara_sales: Any blockers to getting a signed pen-test letter by Thu? We promised them a quick turnaround.

mike_seccops: Only blocker is Legal sign-off on the final language. I'll escalate to Legal now — expect signed letter by Thu EOD if no major redlines. :thumbsup:

alexa_engineering: No engineering blockers. If FinArc needs network allowlist entries, ask for their IP ranges; we can open a temporary whitelist for the POC.

sara_sales: Great — I'll send this bundle over and flag the signed letter is coming. Thanks everyone.

mike_seccops: FYI — note the pen-test attestation is scoped to the environment we test. If they want SaaS-wide attestation, that's a different doc. I'll add that clarification in the letter.

sara_sales: Understood. I'll tell FinArc scope is limited to the POC environment and we will follow up if they need broader coverage.

[thread closed]
